bio: Research Associate Nutrition, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Nutrition Maryam Kazemi, RD, MSc, PhD, CPT is a Women's Health Researcher. Dr. Kazemi has research and clinical experience in Nutrition, Metabolism, Reproductive Endocrinology, and Human Genomics. Her main research interests focus on addressing public health and clinical questions at the intersection of lifestyle behaviors (e.g., diet) and reproductive and cardiometabolic disease risk, particularly polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), cardiovascular disease, and type 2 diabetes, spanning from menarche to post-menopause. She explores these research areas by integrating epidemiological analyses, clinical trial data, and genomics data. BSc, Nutrition and Dietetics Shahid Behehshi University
